title: DexOPD: Dual-Extrapolation On-Policy Distillation for Diffusion Models
abstract: arXiv:2611.31969v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Flow-based diffusion models have become a mainstream paradigm for text-to-image generation, where task-specific post-training produces specialist models with complementary strengths. Multi-teacher on-policy distillation (OPD) offers an efficient way to consolidate these specialists into a single unified student. Recent methods strengthen supervision through teacher extrapolation, constructing stronger proxy teachers that allow distilled students to surpass the original specialists. However, their extrapolation directions remain defined solely by frozen teacher and reference models, leaving the student's own training progress unexploited. To address this limitation, we introduce DexOPD, a dual-extrapolation on-policy distillation method for diffusion models. translated_title: DexOPD：面向扩散模型的双外推在线策略蒸馏
translated_abstract: 基于流的扩散模型已成为文本到图像生成的主流范式，通过任务特定的后训练可以产生具有互补优势的专家模型。多教师在线策略蒸馏（OPD）提供了一种将这些专家模型高效整合为单一统一学生模型的方法。近期的方法通过教师外推来增强监督，构建更强的代理教师，使蒸馏后的学生模型能够超越原始专家模型。然而，这些方法的外推方向仅由冻结的教师模型和参考模型定义，学生模型自身的训练进展未被充分利用。为解决这一局限，我们提出了DexOPD，一种面向扩散模型的双外推在线策略蒸馏方法。DexOPD在保留外推教师监督的同时，利用一个滞后的历史学生模型作为参考进行学生自我外推，并在多个自我外推……（原文摘要在此处截断）
tldr: 提出DexOPD双外推在线策略蒸馏方法，在教师外推监督的基础上引入以滞后历史学生为参考的学生自我外推机制，从而充分利用学生自身训练进展，使扩散模型蒸馏效果超越仅依赖教师外推的现有方法。
en_tdlr: DexOPD introduces a dual-extrapolation on-policy distillation method that augments teacher extrapolation with student self-extrapolation using a lagging historical student as reference, enabling diffusion models to exploit their own training progress and surpass methods relying solely on teacher extrapolation.
